title: Sigil and Spire Anew
author: Noor Pemberton
blurb: Ansel Winterbourne, the keeper of a gate that should stay shut, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
